verdict.rationale: Docs confirm native support for multiple providers (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-compatible, OpenRouter, Ollama) via custom endpoints and librechat.yaml, and agents/conversations can be built 'powered by various model providers' with per-agent selection from the endpoint menu. Missing for 10: explicit mention of Google/Gemini as a provider, and independent/hands-on confirmation of switching models mid-conversation or per-agent in practice.
